fee_notes: Single territory fee is $49,500. Discounts apply when signing multiple Franchise Agreements simultaneously: 2nd territory $40,000, 3rd $35,000, 4th–10th $30,000 each. An Additional Population Fee of $0.25 per person over 200,000 may apply if territory population materially exceeds 200,000. Veterans (honorably discharged) and their spouses receive a 10% discount on the first franchise only (Business must be at least 51% owned by a qualifying veteran). During fiscal year 2025, franchisees paid total initial fees ranging from $3,939 to $30,000.
raw_excerpt:
When you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay us a lump sum initial franchise fee as set forth in the table below. We impose the initial franchise fee uniformly. The initial franchise fee is not refundable under any circumstances.

1st: $49,500 | 2nd: $40,000 | 3rd: $35,000 | 4th–10th: $30,000

During our 2025 fiscal year, Smash My Trash franchisees signing our franchise agreement paid total initial fees to us and/or our affiliates ranging from $3,939 to $30,000.
